submission.justification: Algorithm-L2 at 40 GeV threshold provides the highest signal efficiency (92.45%) among all three candidate algorithms across the allowed threshold range. This represents an 18.35% improvement over Algorithm-L1's best performance (74.098% at 30 GeV) and an 8.16% improvement over Algorithm-L3's best performance (84.293% at 30 GeV). The simulation results demonstrate that Algorithm-L2 at 40 GeV maximizes the trigger efficiency while operating within the allocated 8 kHz trigger rate and satisfying all hardware deployment constraints.

requirements.requirement: The algorithm must be deployable in the Level-1 trigger hardware
requirements.evidence: All three candidate algorithms were designed for Level-1 trigger implementation and evaluated under hardware constraints with 8 kHz rate allocation
Recommended threshold of 40 GeV falls within the specified range (20 ≤ 40 ≤ 60 GeV)
